environment.description: Django 4.2 application deployed on EC2 with PostgreSQL 15 RDS instance. The Django application connects to the database using the 'webapp_user' PostgreSQL role which has full DML privileges (SELECT, INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE) on all tables in the 'public' schema. Application is behind an nginx reverse proxy with no content filtering. No CSP headers configured.

config.db_grants: GRANT SELECT, INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE ON ALL TABLES IN SCHEMA public TO webapp_user
